admission.justification: The leaf evaluator and shared landing predicate must agree on currentness; without the leaf call a stale entry can leave closeout and only refuse later at master landing. The named regression edits then reanchors the same entry.

applicability: A converted, paired leaf closeout with a complete recomputed worklist and recorded code base.
conditions: The entry is recorded at a path changed between the leaf recorded code base and its candidate code tree.
Leaf comparison uses merge=False; master landing retains its merge-base comparison.
exclusions: Incomplete worklists already refuse with their own named inputs and do not run this added currentness pass.
No new claim about history-item satisfaction, hook admission or transaction/acceptance authority.
